title: First run: App Store connected
summary: DJDL's Storefronts right after the App Store connected: the setup card reads 1 of 3 done with Connected the App Store ticked (when and with which key), Create an offer is next with Import from App Store beside New offer, and the App Store row reads Ready, waiting for an offer with an App Store SKU.
compare: The meter is Home's continuous bar at a third; the done step keeps its row with a tick, muted, and says when and with which key it was done, and that store notifications were verified.
Create an offer is now the Next step; because DJDL already has in-app purchases on the App Store, Import from App Store sits beside New offer (primary).
The App Store row reads Ready (info status) at its end, with 'Waiting for an offer with an App Store SKU' under its name; the other storefronts are unchanged.
No page sub-line: the App Store row says what it waits for ('Waiting for an offer with an App Store SKU'), so the state is said once.
No toast: the ticked step is the confirmation (EXPERIENCE.md §7, a toast never duplicates the page). A polite live region announces 'App Store connected'.
Phone: the step's two buttons wrap under its text, the primary first.

findings.issue: Same first-run defects; 'Waiting for an offer' said twice.
findings.resolution: As first-run; 'Waiting for an offer' appears only in the step and the App Store row sub-line is 'Connected Oct 7'.
